page.notes: Left margin: fragments of the facing page's edge (cut numbers and words such as "compa.", "1003 b", "5944") are the neighbouring page and were not transcribed. The mark "3" at the foot is read as a signature and is doubtful. The mark "{menfura" in the entry "patientiæ Dei irritatio" and the reading "scopus" are uncertain; the printed line may read differently. Several page numbers in the right column (for example 1036 b, 1027 a) are small and may be misread. Greek entries are approximated: "παιδεία" in the middle column is a best reading. The entry "pafferculi" (right column, for "pafferculi") is read as printed.
